First get web_page to web_site mapping.\\nquery_wp_site = \\\"\\\"\\\"\\nSELECT wp.wp_web_page_sk, wp.wp_web_site_sk\\nFROM web_page wp\\n\\\"\\\"\\\"\\nwp_site = sql(query_wp_site)\\n# Join\\nws_site = pd.merge(ws_pages, wp_site, on='ws_web_page_sk')\\n# Get web_site info\\nquery_site_info = \\\"\\\"\\\"\\nSELECT web_site_sk, web_name\\nFROM web_site\\n\\\"\\\"\\\"\\nweb_site_info = sql(query_site_info)\\n# Merge to get web_name\\nws_site_name = pd.merge(ws_site, web_site_info, on='web_site_sk')\\n# Join to customer to get current address state\\nquery_cust = \\\"\\\"\\\"\\nSELECT c_customer_sk, ca.ca_state\\nFROM customer c\\nJOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk\\n\\\"\\\"\\\"\\ncust_ca = sql(query_cust)\\n# Filter to CA\\ncust_ca_ca = cust_ca[cust_ca['ca_state'] == 'CA']\\n# Join order numbers\\nws_site_name = pd.merge(ws_site_name, cust_ca_ca, left_on='ws_order_number', right_on='c_customer_sk')\\n# Count per web_name\\nresult = ws_site_name.groupby('web_name').size().reset_index(name='count_star')\\nresult[['web_name', 'count_star']].to_json(orient='records')\\n\"\n}"}
